title: KrossChain
tagline: You now have your control over the Non Fungible tokens by saving your preference on chain
description: Users can now choose to receive the nft on their desired address solving the address mapping problem and letting the users have the control of the assets and the nft rather than the sender. Users can choose the blockchain network and the type of asset that they need. The contracts are deployed on arbitrum, neon evm ,gnosis chain, scroll network, polygonxkevm etc
how_its_made: the destination and source minter contract were deployed on multiple chains with same contract address for efficient cross chain communication. front end is made up of reactjs and it was forked from buidl's scaffold eth. The contracts are deployed on arbitrum, neon evm ,gnosis chain, scroll network, polygonxkevm etc
